label: sec:beta-decay-magic-shells-k12-barrier-bypass-preamble
html: This section specialises the \beta-decay machinery to magic shells. The following blocks establish the double-magic \Delta I bound, identify the k = 12 barrier-bypass mechanism, and derive the magic numbers from the substrate parameter q. We exhibit the canonical examples (non-magic {}^6Li and single-magic {}^{18}O) that test the substrate prediction. The closing blocks lift the substrate-level dictionary into the Bethe–Weizsäcker mass decomposition. They identify the Strutinsky shell-correction term as the graded-trace residue.
